newsitem.title: USA: Timken closes tool steel finishing purchase.
newsitem.headline: Timken closes tool steel finishing purchase.

text.p: The Timken Co said on Monday it completed the purchase of the tool steel finishing and distribution businesses of Sanderson Kayser Ltd., a UK integrated steelmaker, from GEI International plc.

Timken also said it reached a definitive agreement to acquire the tapered roller bearing business of European bearing manufacturer Gnutti Carlo S.p.A.. That is expected to close during the first quarter of 1997.

The company said the acquisitions expanded its geographic presence. The new steel operations would be named Sanderson Special Steels Limited and will be a subsidiary of Latrobe Steel Company, based in Latrobe, Penn., it said.
